description: China Power Plants (points) 2017 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Lex Berman. an extract of 4000 power plants in China from the Global Power Plant Database (World Resource Institute). annual power generation estimates in GWH are included from 2013 to 2017. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: Excel, ZIP, Image, TXT. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
